name: context-canary
description: A context canary with an animated cage, configurable sentinel and automatic recovery.

word.title: Canary word
word.description: Start each final reply with this word or emoji. Run /canary setup after changing it.

autoCompact.title: Automatic compaction
autoCompact.description: Compact after a missing sentinel; disable for notifications only.

cooldownMinutes.title: Recovery window (minutes)
cooldownMinutes.description: A second death within this window locks automatic recovery until /clear. Zero disables the window.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: English or Spanish. This API has no UI locale accessor.

size.title: Canary size
size.description: tiny (3 terminal rows), small (4), normal (6) or large (8).

info.title: Text beside the canary
info.description: none: only the bird (default). status: 'Canary alive/dead'. details: status, streak, death and recovery notes.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints in CLAUDE.md
checkpoints.description: 0 (default): only the rule. 1 to 5: /canary setup spreads code words through CLAUDE.md and every answer must carry them, so the canary samples the whole file and says which part was lost.

target.title: Instruction file
target.description: global: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (default). project: the CLAUDE.md at the root of the project you run /canary setup in. Checkpoints from both files are always checked.
